ai.description: Claude Sonnet 5 becomes default for Free and Pro users, scoring 63.2% on agentic coding benchmarks approaching Opus performance at lower cost.

ai.title: OpenAI GPT-5 Multimodal Release
ai.description: GPT-5 with 2.4 trillion parameters achieves 98.7% accuracy on math olympiad problems and 96.3% on advanced coding challenges.

ai.title: Google Gemini Ultra 2.0 for Science
ai.description: Gemini Ultra 2.0 autonomously designs experiments and identifies new superconductor candidates with 89% accuracy.

funding.title: OpenAI Secures $122B Round
funding.description: OpenAI now valued at levels exceeding most countries with 900M weekly users and $20B annualized revenue, IPO targeted for Q4 2026.

funding.title: MGX Raises $49B AI Fund
funding.description: Abu Dhabi-based MGX closes record $49 billion AI-focused fund from global institutional investors.

funding.title: Shield AI Raises $1.5B
funding.description: Shield AI secures $1.5B for autonomous defense systems and X-BAT drone development, projecting $540M revenue in 2026.

tools.title: .NET July 2026 Servicing Updates
tools.description: Microsoft releases .NET 10.0.10, 9.0.18 and 8.0.29 with security fixes and improvements across all supported versions.

tools.title: WordPress 7.0.1 Maintenance Release
tools.description: WordPress 7.0.1 ships with 13 core bug fixes and Gutenberg 23.5 plugin updates including layout improvements.

tools.title: Temporal Cloud 2.0 Workflow Orchestration
tools.description: Temporal 2.0 adds first-class event-driven architecture support with signals and updates for reliable distributed workflows.

industry.title: EU AI Act Phased Rollout Continues
industry.description: EU AI Act obligations for general-purpose and high-risk systems come into force, requiring transparency and risk classification.

industry.title: US Great American AI Act Passes Senate
industry.description: Senate passes bill 67-31 with preemption of state AI laws and safe harbor for NIST AI Risk Management Framework adoption.

industry.title: UK Launches AI Growth Lab
industry.description: UK establishes AI Growth Lab for legal sector innovation and plans social media ban for under-16s.

oss.title: Kimi K2.5 Open-Source Multimodal Model

oss.title: NVIDIA GR00T 1.7 to LeRobot

oss.title: Llama 4 Scout & Phi-4 Reasoning
oss.description: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout with 10M token context; Microsoft ships Phi-4-reasoning 14B MIT-licensed reasoning model on HF.
